goal.text: Stay safe near the sea after a strong earthquake.

intro.text: You are at the beach. The shaking stopped. The sea is going out!

hint.text: The water can come back fast. Where can it not reach?

lesson.text: Near the sea, a strong earthquake can bring a tsunami. Go to high ground and stay until the all clear.

choices.label: Stay and watch the waves
choices.feedback: Never stay to watch for a tsunami. Go to high ground.

choices.label: Go to high ground right away
choices.feedback: A strong earthquake near the sea can bring a tsunami. Move to high ground now.

choices.label: Wait on the beach for news
choices.feedback: Do not stay in low places by the sea. A warning may not come in time.
